class: A size rule stood in for a validity check, and history was shown as current
symptom: Aristocrat, 29 September: the tailored resume (5,339 bytes) would have been thrown away as 'likely corrupt' on the next retry and written again; and the application's page listed two resumes as 'Documents sent', one from an abandoned earlier attempt, which read as two resumes sent to the employer.
root_cause: reuse_stored_document discarded any stored resume PDF under 20 KB; a text-only tailored resume is about 5 KB. The details page listed every stored document as sent.
why_tests_missed: The reuse test used a 30 KB fake PDF, and no test looked at a job with documents from two attempts.
fix: A stored resume is discarded only when it is not a whole PDF (apply_flow._whole_pdf). The details page marks the newest of each kind 'In use' and older ones 'Earlier attempt'.
prevention: Check what makes a file usable, not a number that happened to fit the first ones seen, and label records from earlier attempts as such.
